earnings.title: E A R N I N G S R E L E A S E
highlights: 3Q 2026 operating revenue of $50.4 billion, up 0.7% from 3Q 2025
3Q 2026 diluted EPS 1 of $6.27 and adjusted diluted EPS 2 of $6.99; results reflect improved operating performance and a net non-operating benefit of $1.85 per share
Operating revenue was $50.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $0.4 billion compared to the prior year quarter.
Operating cash flow of $1.3 billion in the quarter increased $0.1 billion relative to the prior year, primarily reflecting favorable working capital dynamics.

During the third quarter of 2026, the Company repurchased 0.8 million shares of its common stock for $330 million, at a weighted average price of $398.75 per share, and paid a quarterly dividend of $1.72 per share, representing a distribution of cash totaling $373 million.
outlook: FY 2026 diluted EPS 1 guidance raised to at least $22.00; adjusted diluted EPS 2 guidance raised to at least $29.00 on continued operating momentum
FY 2026 operating cash flow guidance raised to at least $6.5 billion

items.heading: If we fail to appropriately predict, price for and manage healthcare costs, the profitability of our products and services could decline, which could adversely affect our business, cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.

A significant reduction in the enrollment in our health benefits programs, pharmacy services or diversified products and services, particularly in states where we have large regional concentrations, could have an adverse effect on our business, cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.
If we fail to responsibly use and protect data, or if such data is found to be inaccurate or unreliable, our business and customers could suffer adverse consequences.

There are various risks and conditions associated with participating in Medicare and Medicaid programs, including payment rates, processes and timelines that are determined by the government, compliance with government contract requirements and regulatory oversight.
A change in our healthcare product mix may impact our profitability.

If we fail to develop and maintain satisfactory relationships with hospitals, physicians, pharmacy service providers and other healthcare providers, our business, cash flows, financial condition and results of operations may be adversely affected.
